notes: Completed story set for Provider Quality Snapshot with full vertical slice.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Provider Quality Snapshot Schema
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a structured schema for provider quality snapshot including credential, specialty, license state, status, enumeration date, and address fields returned from NPI data.
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.evidence: GAP: No explicit schema contract exists for provider quality snapshot; must define based on provider_detail_service.py output fields

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Provider Quality Extraction Logic
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.description: Extract and normalize provider quality fields from NPI registry response within provider_detail_service, ensuring consistent formatting and handling of missing or partial data.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Provider Quality Snapshot via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.description: Integrate provider quality snapshot into evaluate_care_facade response so it can be consumed by the chat layer, ensuring alignment with schema contract.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Quality Snapshot
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.description: Create unit tests for field extraction and normalization and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from NPI lookup through facade to response payload.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.title: Render Provider Quality Snapshot in Chat UI
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.description: Update frontend message rendering to display provider quality snapshot fields (credential, specialty, license state, status, enumeration date, address) in a structured and readable format within the chat interface.
